scispace.question: Which original numerical analysis papers establish Rosenbrock or Rosenbrock-W methods for stiff nonautonomous ordinary differential equations, including the explicit time derivative term and correct restarting at known discontinuities, and what do they say about independently checking dense output accuracy rather than inferring it from accepted-step error estimates?

selected_primary.title: Construction of Rosenbrock–Wanner method Rodas5P and numerical benchmarks within the Julia Differential Equations package

selected_primary.not_claimed: No theorem that this specific modified VigilODE implementation or BASS history satisfies universal stiffness, dense-output, continuum or production guarantees.
